title: The Shawshank Redemption
plot: A quiet banker jailed for a crime he denies befriends a veteran inmate. Over decades he quietly plans a way to reclaim his freedom.

title: The Godfather
plot: An aging mafia patriarch hands his empire to his reluctant youngest son. The heir is slowly pulled into the family's violent business.

title: The Dark Knight
plot: Gotham's masked vigilante faces a chaotic criminal who wants to prove anyone can be corrupted. The city's hope rests on a fragile alliance.

title: Pulp Fiction
plot: Several Los Angeles criminals cross paths in tangled stories told out of order. Each tale turns on luck, loyalty and bad decisions.

title: Forrest Gump
plot: A kind-hearted man with a low IQ drifts through decades of American history. He never stops loving the girl he grew up with.

title: Inception
plot: A thief who steals secrets from dreams is offered a chance to go home if he plants an idea instead. His team descends through layered dreams to do it.

title: The Matrix
plot: A hacker learns his everyday world is a simulation run by machines. He joins a small band of rebels fighting to free humanity.

title: Goodfellas
plot: A boy who dreams of mob life rises through the ranks of a crime family. Greed and paranoia gradually wreck everything he built.

title: Fight Club
plot: A bored office worker starts an underground boxing club with a charismatic stranger. The movement grows into something neither man can control.

title: Star Wars
plot: A farm boy joins a smuggler and a princess to fight a galactic empire. Their target is a moon-sized weapon that can destroy planets.

title: The Empire Strikes Back
plot: The rebels scatter after a crushing defeat while a young pilot trains with a hermit master. A dark enemy closes in on his friends.

title: Jurassic Park
plot: Visitors tour an island park filled with cloned dinosaurs. When the security systems fail, the guests must survive the animals they came to admire.

title: Titanic
plot: A young artist and a society girl fall in love aboard a luxury liner. Their romance is tested when the ship strikes an iceberg.

title: Casablanca
plot: A cynical cafe owner in wartime Morocco meets the lost love who left him. He must choose between his heart and helping her husband escape.

title: Psycho
plot: A woman on the run stops at a remote motel run by a shy young man. Her stay leads to a shocking discovery.

title: Alien
plot: The crew of a cargo ship answers a distress signal and brings something deadly aboard. One by one they are hunted in the dark corridors.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
plot: A reprogrammed machine protects a boy from a shape-shifting killer sent from the future. The boy's mother fights to stop a nuclear war.

title: Back to the Future
plot: A teenager is sent thirty years into the past by a scientist's time machine. He must make sure his parents fall in love so he can exist.

title: Gladiator
plot: A betrayed Roman general is sold into slavery and trained as a fighter. He rises in the arena seeking revenge on the emperor.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
plot: A young trainee agent seeks help from an imprisoned genius to catch a serial killer. The price of his advice is her own secrets.

title: Schindler's List
plot: A businessman in occupied Poland hires Jewish workers for his factory. He gradually spends his fortune to keep them from the camps.

title: Saving Private Ryan
plot: A squad of soldiers crosses war-torn France to find one paratrooper. His brothers have all been killed and the army wants him sent home.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
plot: A young hobbit inherits a ring that must be destroyed in a distant volcano. A mixed company of heroes sets out to guide him.

title: The Lion King
plot: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his uncle schemes against the throne. Years later he returns to face his past.

title: Toy Story
plot: A cowboy doll's place as a boy's favorite is threatened by a new space ranger toy. The two rivals must work together to get home.

title: Finding Nemo
plot: An anxious clownfish crosses the ocean to rescue his son from a diver's fish tank. A forgetful blue fish helps him along the way.

title: Spirited Away
plot: A sulky girl wanders into a world of spirits and bathhouses where her parents are turned into pigs. She takes a job to find a way to free them.

title: Parasite
plot: A struggling family slowly worms its way into the household of a wealthy one. Their clever scheme begins to unravel in unexpected ways.

title: Seven Samurai
plot: Villagers plagued by bandits hire seven masterless warriors to defend them. The group trains the farmers and prepares for a final battle.

title: Heat
plot: A disciplined thief and an obsessive detective circle each other across Los Angeles. Both know a showdown is inevitable.

title: Blade Runner
plot: A weary officer is ordered to hunt escaped artificial humans in a rainy future city. His pursuit makes him question what being human means.

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
plot: An archaeologist races enemy agents to find a legendary relic. His journey takes him from jungle temples to desert tombs.

title: Se7en
plot: Two detectives track a killer whose crimes follow a grim pattern. The nearer they get, the more personal the case becomes.

title: The Departed
plot: An undercover cop and a mob informant inside the police each try to expose the other. Both are running out of time.

title: Interstellar
plot: With Earth's crops failing, a former pilot joins a mission through a wormhole to find a new home. The trip costs him years with his daughter.

title: The Prestige
plot: Two rival stage magicians in Victorian London obsess over outdoing each other's best trick. Their feud grows ever more destructive.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
plot: In a desert wasteland, a drifter helps a rebel driver carry escaped captives away from a tyrant. The pursuit never lets up.

title: La La Land
plot: A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love in Los Angeles. Their ambitions begin to pull them in different directions.

title: Whiplash
plot: A young drummer enters an elite conservatory under a ruthless instructor. His drive to be great pushes him to the edge.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
plot: A devoted hotel concierge and his young lobby boy are caught up in the theft of a priceless painting. Their adventure spans a changing Europe.

title: Get Out
plot: A young man visits his girlfriend's family estate for a weekend. Strange behavior from the hosts reveals a disturbing secret.

title: Jaws
plot: A police chief, a scientist and a fisherman set out to stop a great white shark terrorizing a beach town. The ocean becomes their battlefield.

title: Taxi Driver
plot: A lonely night-shift cabbie grows disgusted with the city's decay. His isolation slowly turns into dangerous resolve.

title: Apocalypse Now
plot: A soldier is sent up a river during the Vietnam War to find a rogue colonel. The journey becomes a descent into madness.

title: Amelie
plot: A shy Parisian waitress secretly arranges small kindnesses for people around her. She struggles to find the courage to pursue her own happiness.

title: No Country for Old Men
plot: A hunter finds a case of money in the desert and a relentless killer follows. An aging sheriff trails them both.

title: The Social Network
plot: A college student builds a website that takes over the world. Friendships and lawsuits follow close behind its success.

title: Coco
plot: A boy who dreams of music is swept into the land of the dead during a festival. He must learn the truth about his family before sunrise.

title: Die Hard
plot: An off-duty cop visiting his wife's office party is trapped when thieves seize the skyscraper. Alone and barefoot, he fights back floor by floor.
